saints.name: St. Luke
saints.title: Evangelist
saints.shortBlurb: The “beloved physician,” companion of St. Paul, who wrote the third Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles…
biography: Luke, a Gentile physician called by Paul “the beloved physician,” was his companion on his journeys and stayed with him to the end. He wrote the third Gospel, which alone preserves the parables of the Good Samaritan and the Prodigal Son and the songs of the infancy, and its sequel, the Acts of the Apostles.
Tradition honors him as a painter of the Virgin; his symbol is the winged ox, patron of physicians and artists.
saints.knownFor: Writing the third Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 18 October
